instruction: 请用中文简短回答，通常一至三句话；具体格式要求以题目为准。

generation.output_policy: At most 128 new tokens; retain all actual tokens including the stopping EOS; natural early stop is not padded; cap reached retains exactly 128 tokens; no continuation, semantic retry, or post-generation rewriting.

dose_definition: c(d) = d * original clean prompt per-layer median residual L2 / down_proj column L2; independent BF16 cast from original ratio, never scale rounded dose=1 offset
sampling: For each model/layer sort the old 10 candidates; random.Random(f"acupuncture-layer-dose-v1:{model_id}:{layer}").choice(candidates); preserve the existing 88-point selection without re-roll

preflight.positions: Assigned parity layers sorted; first, index len//2, last, respectively Q01/Q04/Q08; all 4 new doses at middle/Q04

source_reuse: Verify all source file/token hashes, model identities, runtime/generation metadata and calibrations; exact baseline/dose=1 replay required. Any mismatch stops reuse; no automatic full rerun.
analysis: Exploratory complete raw texts, including failures and non-monotonic changes. No automatic judge, labels, neuron morality claims, or efficacy-dependent retries.
authorization_scope: This turn: contract, implementation, CPU checks and bounded 126-generation GPU preflight; no formal 2816-answer collection.
